observations.body: God addresses Jacob without fear, joins water on thirsty ground to Spirit on offspring and blessing on descendants, and describes people naming themselves as the LORD’s.
observations.label: Water and Spirit are promised to thirsty land and offspring

payload.posture: Read Isaiah 44:1–5 as one movement in Pentecost, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states god addresses Jacob without fear, joins water on thirsty ground to Spirit on offspring and blessing on descendants, and describes people naming themselves as the LORD’s. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Pentecost.
payload.title: Water and Spirit are promised to thirsty land and offspring
